interpretation: Two independent statistics support the composition boundary. (1) Association strength: the ordered index explains median R^2 ~0.99 of the variance of log flux, against a permutation-null median of ~0.02, with no permutation of 300 reaching the observed value (so the p-value is floor-limited at < 1/300). (2) Cross-slice reproduction: the full wavelength profile of the response is reproduced independently by all three temperature slices (pairwise r = 0.90-0.99). Note that this permutation null destroys the ladder ORDER and is therefore degenerate for a rank-1 composition family; it calibrates the association, not the crossover location. For the crossover location, the informative nulls are the monotone-preserving ones in output/verification/GAP3_artefact_nulls.json, under which the boundary moves by <= 0.12 nm at 5300/5800 K.
